title: Stop leaves Codex work running in the same session
outcome: In the active session, after the user issued Stop, Codex/delegated work continued running and later produced output. Investigate cancellation propagation from the UI Stop action through the parent run, delegated runs, process supervision, and late-result delivery. Preserve evidence from session-4982 and ensure stopped work cannot keep consuming compute or append results afterward.
acceptance: Pressing Stop terminates the active Codex run and all owned delegated/process work; no additional assistant/review output is generated after cancellation except a terminal canceled status; verified in the app with a real multi-delegation session.
